import urllib.request
import json

def get_details(acc):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode())

arhgap27 = get_details("Q6ZUM4")
mpo = get_details("P05164")

print("ARHGAP27 (Q6ZUM4):")
print("Protein name:", arhgap27['proteinDescription']['recommendedName']['fullName']['value'])
print("Length:", arhgap27['sequence']['length'], "Mass:", arhgap27['sequence']['molWeight'])

print("\nMPO (P05164):")
print("Protein name:", mpo['proteinDescription']['recommendedName']['fullName']['value'])
print("Length:", mpo['sequence']['length'], "Mass:", mpo['sequence']['molWeight'])

# Check features for MPO:
print("\nMPO features:")
for feature in mpo.get('features', []):
    if feature['type'] in ['Chain', 'Propeptide', 'Signal']:
        print(feature['type'], feature.get('description'), feature['location'])
